Name: Craftable Petter
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Upon obtaining an auto petter thru any means you unlock a crafting recipe to replicate them.

Safe to install mid play through

The mod will automatically detect if you have obtained an auto petter previously and unlock the recipe. 

Crafting recipe is as follows:
     - 5 Iridium Bars
     - 2 Battery packs
     - 10 Refined Quartz
